name: Alpengasthof Lüsens
beschreibung: The Alpengasthof Lüsens is located in the remote Sellrain Valley at an elevation of around 1,630 meters. The accommodation sits at the end of the public access road and serves as the starting point for tours in the Naturpark Stubaier Alpen. The inn functions as an alpine base with a restaurant offering regional Tyrolean cuisine. The rooms are practical and furnished in a traditional style. In summer, guests use the house for hiking, while in winter, they enjoy backcountry skiing in the open terrain. The seclusion of the location is a defining feature. The inn is run by the Raich family in its third generation.
